The instrument features a circular dial with a white face, housed in a brass or gold-toned metallic casing with a wooden outer frame visible at the edges. The dial contains numerical markings (likely pressure values), a central ornate pointer mechanism, and decorative text/indicators. The image has a soft focus and warm lighting.
